name: rfd4_proteina
description: Generate protein/binder backbones with RFD4-Proteina (flow-matching all-atom) on Aurora XPU via the pinned resident-worker route; one row per design (one tile), returns a generated CIF + receipt.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool rfd4_proteina.generate(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=scripts/rfd4_run_row.py, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). 'input' is an absolute path to an ANNOTATED CIF (SA_* columns + condition spec), built with scripts/make_rfd4_input.py or a ready-made benchmark under $RFD4_ENGINE/data/benchmarks/. Distinct seeds are distinct designs; reusing a seed is a replay. The runner resolves the resident wrapper worker-side via row['wrapper'] -> $RFD4_WRAPPER -> $HPC_LOAM_HOME/skills/diffusion-models/rfd4-proteina/scripts/run_rfd4_resident.sh, and the pinned env/checkpoint come from that wrapper (the read-only dkastner deployment, SKILL.md §1). Output existence alone is NOT completion: require rc=0 + receipt.json with matching input/seed (SKILL.md §6).
